verdict.rationale: Claude Design is fundamentally a natural-language, chat-driven interface (prompt to generate mockups, prototypes, SVGs, sliders adjusted via conversation, /design-sync commands, group chat with Claude) and community reports confirm real usage via prompts (e.g., 'Bear on a bicycle' prompt, landing page built via prompts, animated SVG prompting). However some hands-on feedback notes outputs are inconsistent or 'lazy' requiring iterative correction, and no evidence of full autonomous agentic task completion beyond design generation/handoff. missing for 10: independent benchmarking of natural-language command robustness across complex multi-step tasks, evidence of agentic autonomy beyond single-turn prompts.
